title: Module manifest (module.yaml)
description: What a module declares: its name, version, capabilities, events and stores. See spec/modules.md.

name.description: Identifies the module in a node and prefixes its capabilities and events. module, node, network, routing and store are reserved.

events.description: What the module tells subscribers as it happens.

stores.description: The stores the module needs, which the node binds to its own.

config.description: JSON Schema of the module's block in the node definition, which the node checks the block against. Unset means any object.

$defs.description: Schemas the capabilities' schemas refer to, as #/$defs/<name>.

name.description: Unique in the module. Called as <module>.<name>.

access.description: local: only the node itself, its modules and tools. network: other nodes too.

internal.description: Part of a protocol between modules: not announced to other nodes, nor listed by tools.

input.description: JSON Schema of the call's input. Unset means any object.

output.description: JSON Schema of the call's result. Unset means any object.

name.description: Unique among the module's capabilities and events. Subscribed to as <module>.<name>.

schema.description: JSON Schema of the event's body. Unset means any object.

name.description: Unique in the module: how the module names the store in store.* calls.

type.description: entity: records of the entity types below. kv: key-value pairs. blob: bytes under keys, with a content type.

entities.description: The types of records an entity store keeps.

schema.description: JSON Schema of the records. Unset means any object.

indexes.description: Top-level fields records can be queried and sorted by, besides their ID.

schema.description: A JSON Schema (2020-12) of an object.
